# JMK Property Management

> > Full-service property management company serving Miami, Miami Beach, and South Florida with expertise in residential, commercial, and Section 8 housing management.

JMK Property Management, led by Mehdi Khachani, provides comprehensive property management services across South Florida including Plantation, Oakland Park, and Miami Beach. The company specializes in landlord compliance, tenant screening, rent collection, and affordable housing programs while offering bilingual resources for English and Spanish-speaking clients.
